notes: Account background: SynthForge builds a suite of IDE plugins and hosted developer platform for enterprise engineering orgs. Heavy emphasis on low-latency code completions and multi-file code actions (refactors, generate tests).
Primary concern: per-seat monthly unit economics. They have ~2,400 devs but pilot will start with 150 seats. CFO wants clear token vs seat cost and predictable monthly spend.

Technical constraints: need <70ms RTT for inline completions in IDE (edge region), streaming token-by-token to minimize perceived latency, ability to pin model versions per team (stable completions), and deterministic fallbacks if a model upgrade degrades quality.

Security: must integrate with SSO (SAML), company-managed KMS for key wrapping, audit logs retained 1 year, and option for data residency in us-west-2. Air-gapped on-prem for regulated customers is a future ask.

Cost-optimization asks from engineering: aggressive KV/prefix caching for common code patterns, explicit cache warm policies for monorepo bootstraps, recommendations on quantization profiles that preserve code token accuracy (e.g., 4-bit QAT vs 8-bit), and guidance on batching vs latency trade-offs for IDE use-case.
Quote from dev lead: "We need completions to feel instant — if streaming stalls, engineers will disable the plugin. But monthly cost can't blow past budget if we roll to all teams."
POC scope (short):
- Integrate Redwood streaming API into internal IDE plugin (VS Code extension) with model/version pinning
- Evaluate quantized model variant (4-bit) for completion fidelity on TS/Go codebases using their eval prompts
- Implement local prefix cache for top-10k common function stubs and measure token reduction
- Create per-seat cost model: baseline token usage * seat multiplier + reserved capacity vs burst costs
Success metrics for POC: median completion latency <75ms, reduction in token spend >=35% with caching/quantization, and developer acceptance score >=4/5 after 2 weeks

Commercial: interested in Dedicated pools (predictable throughput) and private control plane for SSO/KMS controls. Also wants Optimize to get quantization/batching recommendations and automated alerts on QA regressions.

- Provide example per-seat pricing tiers and a worked example across 150 -> 2,400 seats
- Show kernel/compile-level optimizations Redwood uses for low-latency streaming (edge routing, preemptive KV cache) — engineering asked for a perf whitepaper
- Provide audit/KMS architecture diagram for private deployment
